technical_note: Winner selected by in-sample Sharpe (common pre-OOS window 2002-11-30..2018-01-31) from the 20261016 monthly tournament (5344 IS-valid combos) and evaluated on the held-out OOS window 2018-02-28..2026-05-31 (100 months): OOS Sharpe 0.93 vs B&H 0.89, HAC t 3.26. No frozen-rule confirmation test has been run.
plain_english: This is the rule with the highest in-sample Sharpe among 5344 valid combinations, scored once on the 100-month out-of-sample window: Sharpe 0.93 versus 0.89 for buy-and-hold. It has not been tested on data released after it was chosen.
next_step: Freeze the rule and evaluate it on months released after the freeze date.
